{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I'm getting really tired of this mopak.|[[Jos Vondar]]|<ref name="Medstar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>}}
'''Mopak''' was a swear word that had several different meaning, depending on the context: It could refer to nonsense, e.g. "pure mopak"<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> or "utter [[grasser]] mopak";<ref name="Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> trouble; e.g. "in deep mopak";<ref name="Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> a bad situation, e.g. "all the mopak [[Jax Pavan|Jax]] had been through."<ref name="Twilight" /> or something of bad quality, e.g. "He's a mopak [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]."<ref name="Leebo">{{InsiderCite|128|And Leebo Makes Three}}</ref> It could also be used as an insult, such as "the stupid mopak"; or as an exclamation, e.g. "milking mopak."<ref name="Death Star" /> The phrase "scare the mopak out of" meant to terrify someone.<ref name="Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
